name: How Welding Works
title: How Welding Works

name: How Brazing Works
title: How Brazing Works
description: Brazing joins with filler melting above 450C but below base metal melting: capillary action draws filler into the joint. Less heat, less distortion than welding.
how_it_works: Design for capillary gaps (typically 0.03-0.13mm), clean and flux properly, heat evenly, and let capillary action work. Cleanliness is everything.
requirements: Defined joint design; qualified procedure (WPS); capable equipment; verified welder skill.
standards: AWS D1.1 structural welding; ASME Section IX welding qualification; AWS brazing standards.
citations: AWS D1.1/D1.1M structural welding code - steel.
